# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-13 from the 2026-11-13 Hub dump.

- 3,231,993 models tracked, 929,152 declare a base model, 962,455 parent links, 92,096 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
